summary.title: 为 Mainline PR Intent Action 增加 fork PR 支持
summary.what: 将 Mainline PR Intent workflow 迁移为单一 pull_request_target 路径：同仓 PR 继续 checkout 并执行 head 代码，fork PR 只 checkout 可信 base，并把 PR head 作为 Git 数据读取。pr-comment 新增可选的 fork URL/PR 参数，可从 fork actor refs 临时投影 contributor-published intents，复用原有 commit-range、多 intent、branch fallback、marker 和 sticky comment 行为。加入并发取消、head 新鲜度校验、live PR body 检查和临时 ref 清理，并补充 engine/CLI 回归测试。
summary.why: 普通 pull_request 在 fork PR 上只有只读 token，无法写评论；直接移除同仓限制又会让高权限 job 执行不可信 fork 代码。新的可信 base 执行路径在不改变现有同仓评论能力的前提下安全读取 fork intent metadata，并避免在 review 阶段导入或修改 upstream Mainline 状态。
summary.user_goal: 在保持现有同仓 PR 行为不变的基础上，为 Mainline PR Intent Action 增加 fork PR 支持并提交 PR

decisions.point: GitHub Actions 触发与 checkout 模型
decisions.chose: 使用单一 pull_request_target workflow；同仓 checkout head，fork checkout 精确 base SHA。
decisions.rationale: 保持一个稳定的 Mainline PR Intent check，避免 fork 同时出现旧 Skipped 和新 check；fork 路径始终只运行 default/base 上的可信代码。
rejected: 保留 pull_request 再新增 fork-only workflow，因为 GitHub 无法在 on 层按 head repo 过滤，会产生重复或 Skipped checks

decisions.point: fork intent metadata 的信任边界
decisions.chose: 只把 fork actor refs fetch 到临时 imports refs 并物化只读 view；upstream canonical intent 同 ID 时始终优先。
decisions.rationale: PR comment 是 review surface，不是 actor-log acceptance；预览不能调用 ImportActorLog、写 canonical actor refs/notes/view 或 push。
rejected: 在 PR 打开阶段复用 pr-import，因为它会接受 contributor metadata 并可能更新 upstream refs/notes

decisions.chose: 复用现有 commit-range 优先、多 intent、branch fallback、排序和 Markdown renderer，并给未接受的 fork intent 增加 provenance 提示。
decisions.rationale: reviewer 获得与同仓 PR 一致的 intent 内容，同时能区分 contributor-published metadata 尚未被 upstream 接受。

decisions.chose: 按 PR 号取消旧 run，并在生成前后校验 live head/body。
decisions.rationale: 防止 synchronize/edited 的旧事件覆盖新评论；PR body 已有 Mainline marker 时直接清理旧 sticky comment 并成功退出。

rejected.alternative: 只删除原 workflow 的同仓 if 条件
rejected.reason: fork pull_request token 仍无法写评论，而且把可写 token 与 fork head 代码放在一起会形成高风险执行边界。

rejected.alternative: 只让 fork job 成功但不读取 fork actor log
rejected.reason: 只能消除 Skipped，缺少 PR body marker 时仍无法展示 contributor 已发布的 sealed intent，不满足完整能力支持。

review_notes: 验证通过：go vet ./internal/engine ./internal/cli；golangci-lint v1.62.2；actionlint v1.7.12；git diff --check。
使用真实 PR #203 的 base/head/fork URL 本地演练，成功只读渲染 int_5a162dfc；canonical actor ref、Mainline notes/view 未改变，临时 pr-comments refs 已清理。
pull_request_target workflow 必须先合入 default branch，之后才能通过编辑 #203 产生 fresh event 验证线上 run。

architectural_claims: Fork PR comment generation is an upstream-side trusted-code workflow; fork commits and actor logs are data inputs and are never executed.
Review-time fork intent projection is read-only and separate from post-merge actor-log acceptance/import.
Upstream canonical Mainline intents take precedence over fork preview intents with the same intent ID.
Same-repository PR comment rendering remains on the existing head-code path while fork PRs use base-code execution.
behavioral_changes: Mainline PR Intent runs for same-repository and fork PR opened, edited, synchronize, and reopened events.
Fork PRs can render contributor-published sealed intents from fork actor refs when the PR body lacks the Mainline description marker.
Contributor-published fork intents are labeled as not yet accepted into the upstream Mainline log.
PRs whose live body already contains the Mainline description marker succeed without generating a duplicate comment and remove any stale sticky fallback comment.
Stale PR events no longer update comments after the live head SHA changes.
security_implications: Fork jobs checkout only the trusted base SHA with persisted checkout credentials disabled, and invoke pr-comment with --no-sync.
Fork actor logs are read from temporary refs that are deleted after projection; the comment path never calls ImportActorLog or writes/pushes upstream refs and notes.
PR payload fields are passed through environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.
Concurrency and live head/body checks prevent stale runs from overwriting current PR comment state.
The workflow retains write access only for PR/issue comment management; repository contents remain read-only.
migration_notes: No persisted Mainline schema or data migration is required.
The workflow change becomes active only after it is merged into the repository default branch.
Existing pr-comment callers without fork flags keep the previous API and output behavior.
